# `csharp_place_simple_enum_on_single_line`

Allow a short enum body to stay on one line.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `true` |  |
| `false` |  |

**Default:** `true`

## Example

::::{tab-set}

:::{tab-item} Before
```csharp
namespace N;

public enum Status
{
    Active,
    Inactive,
    Pending,
}
```
:::

:::{tab-item} After
```csharp
namespace N;

public enum Status
{
    Active,
    Inactive,
    Pending,
}
```
:::

::::

*Curb recognises this key but does not yet reformat this construct — Before and After are identical.*
